lines.en: Growl and munch on fresh leaves.

lines.zh: 巡逻路线，寻找敌人踪迹。
lines.en: Patrol the route, seek enemy signs.
Wander through the grass, alert to surroundings.
Step quietly, eyes wide for danger.
Chomp on grass, make rustling sounds.

lines.zh: 警惕地巡视，不放过任何动静。
lines.en: Alertly patrol, no sound goes unheeded.

lines.zh: 行进中，偶尔啃食地上的叶子。
缓慢移动，仔细检查地面。

lines.en: I lead the column with the banner up.
I keep the pace slow for my recruits.
I finish this stretch along the wall.

lines.zh: 停下来在土路上做记号
lines.en: I stop to mark the dirt path.
I count the recruits behind me.
I cross the field with my shield up.
Stand in the grass, waiting for orders.

lines.zh: 日头正好，队伍就地歇脚。
lines.en: The sun is good; the squad rests where it stands.

lines.zh: 闲适地吃着地上的叶子。
低头寻找食物，似乎在思考。
慢慢行走，寻找新的巡逻点。
lines.en: Walk slowly, searching for new patrol points.

lines.zh: 静静站立，准备随时行动。

lines.en: I spread the map on my knee.
I sharpen my blade until dark.
I watch recruits practice their swings.
I dress the line and count supplies.
I lean my shield on a tree and rest.
I keep my eyes on the far wall.
Stare at the player, waiting alertly.

lines.zh: 发现玩家，立刻报告坐标。
锁定玩家，准备报告位置。
lines.en: Lock onto the player, ready to report position.

lines.zh: 警惕观察，寻找玩家踪迹。
lines.en: Alertly observe, searching for the player.

lines.zh: 发现玩家，立刻发出警告。
注视玩家，准备上报信息。
lines.en: Watch the player, ready to report.

lines.zh: 锁定目标，报告玩家坐标。
寻找玩家，准备报告位置。
lines.en: Search for the player, ready to report.
Lock on to the player, report coordinates.

lines.zh: 观察玩家，准备上报敌情。
lines.en: Observe the player, ready to report enemy positions.
I size up the emeralds in your hand.
I raise a hand in salute.
Blood drips from my sleeve onto my boots.

lines.zh: 这一刀切开了我的肩甲。

lines.en: The line's broken — I have to hold.
On my knees, I am still counting the squad.

lines.zh: 盾牌被劈开了一道口子...
我看到远处的果实了，真诱人！
lines.en: Fruit over there, must taste good.

lines.zh: 草地上鲜美的叶子真香啊！
lines.en: Grass leaves so fresh, must be tasty.

lines.zh: 森林边缘的树叶正等我去啃呢！
lines.en: Leaves at the forest edge await me.

lines.zh: 我得去吃点树皮，营养丰富！
lines.en: Need to munch on some bark, rich in nutrients.

lines.zh: 这些浆果肯定很美味，尝尝吧！
lines.en: Berries must be delicious, try one.

lines.zh: 那边的苔藓看起来很柔软，可以吃！
lines.en: Moss looks soft, must be edible.

lines.zh: 蘑菇长出来了，赶紧去尝一尝！
树叶间的露珠，我得去舔一舔！
lines.en: Dew on leaves, must taste good.

lines.zh: 果实在枝头晃动，一定是好东西！
这片草地上的叶子最适合吃！
lines.en: These grass leaves are perfect to eat.
The bread is fresh out of the oven.
An apple rolls in the basket.

lines.zh: 烤马铃薯的味飘过来了

lines.en: The carrot tops still have soil on them.
Is there beet enough for the whole squad?
Eat first, then we can stand watch.

lines.zh: 警觉！我们撞上了巡逻队！
lines.en: Alert! We’ve bumped into the patrol squad.

lines.zh: 别靠近！这里有巡逻士兵！
巡逻队发现我们了，快躲起来！
巡逻队来了，别发出声响！
巡逻队注意到了我们，小心！
小心巡逻队，他们会攻击！
我的伴侣，一起看守防线！
lines.en: My mate, watch the line together.

lines.zh: 和伴侣一起巡视，很重要！
和伴侣一起巡逻，感觉很安心！
lines.en: Patrol with my mate, feels secure.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣，守护这片土地！
和伴侣一起，巡逻更有效！
lines.en: Together with my mate, patrolling works.
Together with my mate, protect our home.

lines.zh: 哨兵集结完毕，前往预定位置。
lines.en: Sentinels assembled, heading to designated positions.
New recruits are ready, let's move out.

lines.zh: 巡逻路线开启，注意周围环境。

lines.en: Food supply is good, let's continue.
Patrol complete, heading back to base.

lines.zh: 敌方坐标锁定，准备行动。
lines.en: Enemy coordinates acquired, prepare to act.

lines.zh: 观察敌人动态，随时准备。
lines.en: Monitor the enemy, ready at all times.

lines.zh: 保持警惕，敌人可能就在附近。
lines.en: Stay alert, enemies may be nearby.

lines.zh: 情报显示，目标正在移动。
敌方行动频繁，加强戒备。
敌人动向不明，继续搜索。
敌人坐标传输中，请等待。
新兵注意，对敌行动即将开始。

lines.en: Commander, I have the target locked.

lines.zh: 新兵注意方位，准备攻击。
lines.en: Recruits, mark your positions, prepare to attack.

lines.zh: 敌人位置确认，准备攻击。
lines.en: Enemy position confirmed, prepare to attack.

lines.zh: 新兵跟随攻击，注意安全。
lines.en: Recruits, follow the attack, be cautious.

lines.zh: 新兵注意，攻击命令已发。
我的制服烧穿了，队伍还在。
lines.en: My uniform is burnt through; the squad stands.

lines.zh: 水灌进盔甲，我拖不动腿
lines.en: Water fills my armor and my legs drag.
The blast tore my shield away.
An arrow punched through my pauldron.
Supplies ran out and my grip fails.

lines.zh: 雷劈在旗杆上，我扶着才没倒。
lines.en: Lightning hit the standard; I lean on it to stay upright.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，队伍还在等我。
lines.en: The ground is gone, and the squad is still waiting.
